findings.body: This fixture uses a channel ID ending in `@thread.tacv2`, but its only Graph membership interceptor handles `/chats/.../members`. The changed membership validator classifies that ID as a channel and requests team/channel discovery followed by `/teams/{team}/channels/{channel}/members`. Those requests have no interceptor, and the Microsoft harness disables external networking, so membership verification fails closed and the permitted submitter cannot complete the required approval scenario. Update the Microsoft HTTP fixtures to cover the actual channel membership requests and verify that the waiting flow resolves.
